query: Do Kaplan-style scaling laws and the Chinchilla study agree on how to split a fixed compute budget between model size and training tokens?
query_es: ¿Coinciden Kaplan y Chinchilla en cómo repartir un presupuesto de cómputo entre tamaño del modelo y tokens?
claim_under_test: Compute-optimal training should favor very large models on modest data.

query: Are emergent abilities of large language models a real effect of scale or an artifact of the chosen evaluation metric?
query_es: ¿Las habilidades emergentes son un efecto real de la escala o un artefacto de la métrica?
claim_under_test: Emergent abilities are a fundamental property of scale.

query: Which work defines an ability as emergent when it is absent in smaller models and cannot be predicted by extrapolating them?
query_es: ¿Qué trabajo define una habilidad emergente como ausente en modelos pequeños e impredecible por extrapolación?
claim_under_test: Emergence cannot be predicted by extrapolating smaller models.

query: Are chain-of-thought explanations a faithful account of why the model produced its answer?
query_es: ¿Las explicaciones chain-of-thought reflejan fielmente por qué el modelo respondió?
claim_under_test: CoT explanations reveal the model's true reasoning process.

query: Do language models need hand-crafted few-shot exemplars to benefit from step-by-step reasoning?
query_es: ¿Los modelos necesitan ejemplos few-shot para beneficiarse del razonamiento paso a paso?
claim_under_test: Step-by-step reasoning requires few-shot demonstrations.

query: Does sampling several reasoning paths and taking the most consistent answer beat greedy decoding in chain-of-thought prompting?
query_es: ¿Muestrear varios caminos de razonamiento supera al greedy decoding en CoT?
claim_under_test: Self-consistency sampling outperforms greedy CoT decoding.

query: For injecting new factual knowledge into an LLM, is retrieval-augmented generation better than unsupervised fine-tuning?
query_es: ¿Para inyectar conocimiento nuevo, RAG es mejor que el fine-tuning no supervisado?
claim_under_test: RAG outperforms unsupervised fine-tuning for knowledge injection.

query: Do language models use relevant information placed in the middle of a long input context as well as information at the beginning or end?
query_es: ¿Los modelos usan igual de bien la información en medio de un contexto largo que al inicio o al final?
claim_under_test: Long-context models use all positions of the context robustly.

query: Does sharing keys and values across attention heads degrade model quality compared with multi-head attention?
query_es: ¿Compartir keys y values entre cabezas degrada la calidad frente a multi-head attention?
claim_under_test: Sharing K/V heads causes quality degradation.

query: Is Direct Preference Optimization superior to PPO-based RLHF for aligning language models?
query_es: ¿DPO es superior a PPO (RLHF) para alinear modelos de lenguaje?
claim_under_test: DPO outperforms PPO for alignment.

query: Can a much smaller model fine-tuned with human feedback be preferred by humans over a far larger model?
query_es: ¿Un modelo mucho más pequeño entrenado con feedback humano puede preferirse a uno mucho mayor?
claim_under_test: A small RLHF model can be preferred to a 100x larger model.

query: Does 4-bit weight quantization preserve the performance of large language models?
query_es: ¿La cuantización de pesos a 4 bits preserva el rendimiento de los LLM?
claim_under_test: 4-bit quantization keeps performance close to full precision.

query: Does quantizing a large language model always make inference faster?
query_es: ¿Cuantizar un LLM siempre acelera la inferencia?
claim_under_test: Quantization always speeds up inference.

query: Can a transformer trained on short sequences extrapolate to longer sequences at inference time, or should positions be interpolated instead?
query_es: ¿Un transformer entrenado con secuencias cortas puede extrapolar a secuencias largas, o conviene interpolar posiciones?
claim_under_test: Extrapolating positions beyond the training length is reliable.

query: Do approximate linear-complexity attention methods deliver real wall-clock speedups over exact attention?
query_es: ¿Los métodos de atención aproximada lineal logran aceleración real en tiempo de reloj?
claim_under_test: Approximate attention yields real wall-clock speedups.

query: Is there an established consensus on how to evaluate efficient transformers on long sequences?
query_es: ¿Existe consenso sobre cómo evaluar transformers eficientes en secuencias largas?
claim_under_test: There is consensus on evaluating efficient transformers.

query: Do dense retrievers outperform BM25, especially in zero-shot settings?
query_es: ¿Los recuperadores densos superan a BM25, especialmente en zero-shot?
claim_under_test: Dense retrieval outperforms BM25.

query: Does in-context learning require correct ground-truth labels in the demonstrations?
query_es: ¿El in-context learning requiere etiquetas correctas en las demostraciones?
claim_under_test: Correct labels in demonstrations are not required.

query: Does LoRA match the quality of full fine-tuning?
query_es: ¿LoRA iguala la calidad del fine-tuning completo?
claim_under_test: LoRA matches full fine-tuning quality.

query: How much do architectural details such as network width or depth affect language model loss compared with scale?
query_es: ¿Cuánto afectan el ancho o la profundidad de la red a la pérdida frente a la escala?
claim_under_test: Width and depth have minimal effect on loss.

query: Do state space models such as Mamba outperform Transformers on language modeling?
query_es: ¿Los modelos de espacio de estados como Mamba superan a los Transformers en modelado de lenguaje?
claim_under_test: State space models outperform Transformers.

query: How many tokens was Llama 3 trained on relative to the Chinchilla-optimal amount?
query_es: ¿Con cuántos tokens se entrenó Llama 3 respecto al óptimo de Chinchilla?
claim_under_test: Llama 3 was trained far beyond the Chinchilla-optimal token count.
